title: oci-free
tagline: The free-tier ARM VM this site runs on, as code
description: Infrastructure as code for one free-tier ARM VM running k3s: the VM and its network in Terraform, the cluster's manifests, and the rollout that puts this site on it. Notes on what was built and why.
